newsitem.title: UK: U.S. law firm Cadwalader to set up London office.
newsitem.headline: U.S. law firm Cadwalader to set up London office.

text.p: U.S. law firm Cadwalader, Wickersham and Taft on Monday said it recruited four partners from three leading UK law firms to form the nucleus of a new office in London.
It said in a statement its London office, scheduled to open on September 1, would have over 25 British lawyers and serve as a "hub for its international business growth and client service".
The office will build on Cadwalader's financial services practice, with the emphasis on structured finance, insurance, insurance insolvency and corporate transactions.
Andrew Wilkinson joins from Clifford Chance, James Starkey from Freshfields, while John Walker and Russell Jacobs both join from Wilde Sapte.
